title_block: LOCATION AND ACCESS PLAN / MT. ANGEL ABBEY LIBRARY, ST. BENEDICT, OREGON
contents: Overall site plan with topography contours, 'List of Drawings' index, 'Key to Symbols', and project title info.
Detailed site layout including roads, topography, existing buildings, and several sections showing stairs and typical tread details.
First level floor plan including fan-shaped layout outline, corner details, splitting details, and general notes.
Second level floor plan denoting reading areas, stacks, mechanical areas, and general layout notes.
Main floor plan showing entry, control desk, offices, and radiating curved bookshelves.
Geometrical and structural layout of the fan shape, showing radial column lines and several window/jamb details (West Jamb, East Jamb).
Layout of the roof with skylights, parapet walls, sill details, flashings, scuppers, and built-up roofing areas.
Ceiling layout showing lighting placement over the stacks & reading areas on the first floor.
Ceiling grid and lighting layout for the second floor, including typical carrell details.
Third-level ceiling plan, particularly detailing the skylight ceiling screens, transitions, and oculus layouts.
East and West Elevations, section details of window slats, supports, and shade systems.
North and South Elevations, wood screen sections/plans, and window/glazing dimension points.
Major building cross-sections (Section A-A, Section B-B), detail cutaways of the stairs, catalog desks, and structural elements.
Wall-by-wall interior elevations for spaces like Corridors, Stacks, Receiving, and Bindery.
Interior wall elevations for Seminar Rooms, Periodical Lounge, Dark Room, Print Room, and Stacks.
Detailed interior elevations of the Entry Area, Lobby, Rare Book & Meeting Room, and A/V Control Booth.
Details of wall construction from footings to the roof, including section views through the stairwells and retaining walls.
Specific construction details of the sloping skylights, sills, and continuous parapets across the library.
Comprehensive list of doors, hardware, thresholds, jamb details, and head conditions.
Room Finish Schedule detailing floor, base, wall, and ceiling finishes across the library. Also shows partition types and structural wall details.
High-resolution sections and plans of window assemblies, including frames, jambs, sills, mullions, and headers.
Detailed architectural plans, vertical sections, and specific details (handrail brackets, tread/riser profiles) for Stair 1 and Stair 2.
Comprehensive routing, vertical sections, and plans for the remaining interior stairs and the elevator core.
Detailed drawings for wood screens, mullions, fire hose cabinets, baseboards, and specific trim/batten intersections.
Detailed millwork package for the famous curved Control Desk and various reading carrels (small/large, open/closed), including dutch doors and shelving.
Layouts for men’s and women’s restrooms (Levels 1, 2, 3), and specific structural connections, fascia, and column details for the Entry Canopy.
Dedicated layout for bookshelf placement on Level 1, detailing double-faced versus single-faced units against walls.
Dedicated bookshelf layout for Level 2, including book capacity schedules and spacing dimensions.
Expansive bookshelf arrangements for the main fan-shaped upper floor (Level 3) with exact book capacities delineated into zones.
Foundation layouts, concrete/steel specs, typical wall sections, construction joints, anchors, retaining wall reinforcement schedules, and the Structural List of Drawings.
Layout indicating column grid, footing locations, slab dimensions, and bearing walls for Level 1.
Detailed structural framing grid for Level 2, defining major girders, beams, floor slabs, and load paths.
The framing blueprint for the expansive upper deck (Level 3), displaying beam and girder networks supporting the fan shape.
Upper roof and vault ceiling framing, showing support structures for the complex skylights and radial roof spans.
Profiles of typical spread footings, grade beams, step elevations, elevator pit, and typical slab-on-grade conditions.
Sectional elevations and reinforcing layouts for Level 2 Girders and Beams.
Extensive sectional elevations of major Level 3 Girders.
Continuing sectional elevations specifically detailing Level 3 Beams.
Further detail of Level 3 Beams and specific connections.
Structural elevations of specific interior shear walls or load-bearing corridor walls.
More detailed shear wall and foundation wall structural elevations showing reinforcing bars.
Rebar layouts, slab thickness, and anchoring details for concrete monolithic stairs (Stairs No. 1, 2, 4, 5).
Specifications for distinctive steel H-columns connecting to the building framework and supporting the roof around the skylights.
Reinforcing schedules for round columns, mezzanine slab reinforcement plans, and specialized splice details.
Metal decking connections, wide flange (WF) to corner wall joints, paired circular column attachments, and bracket assemblies.
Focus on the main skylight framing details, skewed bracing, and header beam integration.
Site retaining wall layouts and extensive rebar schedules for retaining walls and the Entry Canopy foundation.
